messages.author: 45e88ddada548644
messages.subject: Having trouble installing on Windows 7
parts:
When I run the RRO installer .exe, it asks me for authorization to run it, I click the "run" button, and then after a few moments the .exe. disappears from my downloads folder, but nothing appears to happen.  No other system prompts, and I can't find RRO.

Can anyone help?

Thanks,

Brian

messages.author: 2aed7cbfca222ffd
messages.subject: Re: Having trouble installing on Windows 7
parts:
Could it be that you do not have permissions to install under the 'C:\Program Files' folder as the user who is running the installer?
Some organizations do not allow their employees to install personally under this folder, which is where we install by default.

If that is the case, you need to change the default installation path to something else, for example 'C:\Users\<YourLogin>\RRO' and it should install fine. Is that potentially the problem?


Stephen Weller
Revolution R Open Technical Support

messages.author: 2aed7cbfca222ffd
messages.subject: Re: Having trouble installing on Windows 7
parts:
Hi Brian,

The RRO Installer currently does not log any info about the install, so we have no good way of knowing what might be the problem here.

One thing you could do, if you are willing to investigate the problem further from your end, would be to install the Windows application 'Process Monitor'.  Process Monitor will report detailed problems on Windows applications and you can configure it to create a output log file. If you can do that and email us the resulting log file, we can take a closer look at the problem.

Here is more information on how to use Process Monitor:
http://www.winhelponline.com/blog/process-monitor-track-events-generate-log-file/


If you can do this and monitor the RRO Windows installer executable, that might help us track down the problem.

Stephen Weller
Revolution R Open Technical Support
